Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent PIXEL ART animation atlas for the same Lirian character as the provided game sprite reference, NOT a poster.
The input image is an IDENTITY AND PIXEL-STYLE reference only, not an edit target. Match EXACTLY her face/proportions, long pale silver-pink hair and red rose, black fitted steel/leather armor with silver trim, crimson split cape/coattails, armored gloves and black thigh-high boots, ONE one-handed silver sword. Keep her fully in the same costume. No nudity, costume redesign, hood, teal hunter, additional weapons or added characters.
Crisp chunky pixel clusters and dark outline matching reference small RPG sprite, compact proportions. Fixed elevated 3/4 top-down camera. Anatomical body size is the SAME in every pose and direction. Whole sprites including long hair, cape and sword fully contained in their own cells with HUGE true transparent gutters. Each entire sprite fits within the CENTRAL 60% WIDTH AND 60% HEIGHT of each cell. Body is about 100 pixels tall at native sprite size. Keep all sprites SMALL with lots of empty space, don't fill their cells. No overlaps with adjacent sprites or canvas edges. No text, row labels, borders, floor, shadows, trails, blood, flashes, haze or colored halos. Transparent RGBA only.
EXACTLY FIVE equal rows. Row order SOUTH front toward viewer, SOUTHEAST front-right three-quarter, EAST right-facing profile, NORTHEAST rear-right facing away, NORTH true back with NO visible face. Keep this facing through each row. For rightward views the head stays right-facing. Never turn around in the middle of an action. Never rotate the whole bitmap in-plane.
The same world foot/ground anchor is centered horizontally in each cell and at 78% cell height. Animate in place; feet/ground anchor do not drift between frames. Clearly different articulated poses, not duplicates or mere shifts of an idle sprite.
EXACTLY FOUR equal columns, TWENTY sprites total. Each row is a non-looping DEFEAT/FALL sequence. Columns 1–4: 1 upright stagger, knees buckle and sword lowers, same normal body scale; 2 one knee drops and torso slumps, off-hand braces toward ground; 3 falls sideways toward ground, hair/cape spill naturally, sword stays with right hand; 4 lies motionless on ground in a clear fallen silhouette, whole body and sword visible. Final sprite is HORIZONTAL/low because she lies down, DO NOT make it taller or resize it to the standing height. Keep same anatomical proportions. North-facing row maintains back-of-head/back view in falling/fallen frames, never shows a frontal face. All four sprites retain one centered consistent ground anchor; final body lies around that anchor. No gore or injury marks, no detached sword, no rotation shortcut of a standing sprite.
